verdict: No paid ads running; a broken call button is the one urgent fix.
narrative: No paid spend was active on Meta or Google this period, so all activity came through organic channels. Your Google Business Profile appeared in 101 impressions and prompted 81 direction requests over the last 28 days — healthy signs of local visibility — but generated zero calls, which points to a broken or misconfigured call button on the profile. That is being fixed now. Website traffic held steady at 707 sessions this period with no paid support driving it, which is a reasonable organic baseline to build from. Once the call button is repaired and the pre-launch setup items are cleared, paid campaigns will be in a position to go live and convert that existing traffic into tracked leads.
